## Case studies

- [Studio Tools](https://www.aashikkumarmahato.com.np/projects/studio-tools): AI image, OCR and PDF toolkit — React 19, Express 5, FastAPI + rembg, Upscayl
- [Automated Attendance System](https://www.aashikkumarmahato.com.np/projects/automated-attendance-system): Face-recognition attendance with Python, YOLOv8, React and MongoDB
- [Ultrasonic Blind Stick with GSM/GPS](https://www.aashikkumarmahato.com.np/projects/ultrasonic-blind-stick): Arduino assistive device with obstacle detection and emergency location sharing
- [Smart School Management System](https://www.aashikkumarmahato.com.np/projects/smart-school-management): MERN school administration platform
- [WeatherApp](https://www.aashikkumarmahato.com.np/projects/weather-app): Next.js AI weather dashboard
- [Raghunathpur Cable Network Website](https://www.aashikkumarmahato.com.np/projects/cable-network-website): Production website for a local ISP
